observation: Pi-diff-patch-apply baseline saturates at 0.99 with easy Python primitives. The 4B model has very strong patch-apply skills baked in. To find headroom, need either harder tasks (more complex multi-function code, harder algorithms) or tighter rubric (strict format requirements).
Pi 0.75.3 does NOT support --max-turns flag. Turn budget must be enforced via wall-clock timeout (e.g. `timeout 180s pi -p ...`). Documented in rollout.py — max_turns arg is now diagnostic-only.

Pi sessions on L40S at parallel=4 take 60-150s wallclock per rollout. Each iter (12 tasks × 4 gens) ≈ 25-30 min rollouts. At this cadence, 50 iters takes 25+ hours. To fit overnight, reduce to 8 tasks × 3 gens (~12 min/iter).

Strict format rubric (4 pillars: completion + file_ref + bullet_or_summary + verb_of_intent) lifted format headroom from 0.05 to 0.24. Composite ceiling stays at 1.0 by dropping outcome_base 0.50 → 0.40. Baseline shifts 0.961 → 0.942.
Default variance filter 0.04 drops EVERYTHING when baseline is near-saturated. Lowered to 0.005 to keep even tiny-variance groups. Has fallback in run_iter.sh: if <2 groups pass filter, use full set.

iter 1: 6 hard tasks × 3 gens, 18 rollouts in ~10 min, only 1 group had variance >0.005. Most groups: either all-pass (drift, clean) or all-fail (incorrect-hunk timeouts). For GRPO signal, need EITHER lower variance threshold OR tasks where outcome flips within the group.
cuda_grpo_ablation phase1 with rank-16 LoRA on 6-group dataset trains in ~100s on L40S. Adapter is 61MB. So training step itself isn't the bottleneck — rollouts are.

note: kiln-runpod:latest image does NOT pre-install pytest. Rollouts that run pytest in workdir get "No module named pytest". Bootstrap must "pip install pytest".

Fresh /usr/bin/pi defaults to provider=google. Pi sessions bail in <2s with "No API key found for the selected model". Must run "kiln pi-setup" to write ~/.pi/agent/{models,settings}.json before launching rollouts.
kiln serve without --features cuda runs in CPU mode (model loads, /v1/adapters works, but inference is unusably slow). Bootstrap_pod.sh MUST do "cargo build --release --features cuda".

kiln-flash-attn build.rs defaults to KILN_CUDA_ARCHS=80;89;90 (A100/Ada/H100). Each arch builds ~7 kernel .o files × ~1-2 min each. On A6000 (sm_86, PTX-compatible with 80), setting KILN_CUDA_ARCHS=80 cuts build time ~3x. Worth setting in bootstrap.

KILN_MODEL_PATH=/workspace/qwen3.5-4b. HF repo is Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (not Qwen2.5). Earlier draft of bootstrap had the wrong name and downloaded a model whose weight prefix didn't match kiln's loader expectations.

Launching "nohup bash script.sh | head -50 &" in the Claude bash tool: head closes the pipe after 50 lines, parent script gets SIGPIPE on next echo and dies. Do NOT pipe through head when running drive scripts in background; redirect to a file instead.
